threads_addressed.summary: Duplicate and overlap checks now compare instance classes by resolved class identity, so alias-equivalent heads are rejected at declaration time.
Local-vs-imported duplicate and overlap checks now respect class identity, so hidden imported same-named class instances can coexist with a local class instance.

changes: Changed local duplicate instance detection to use sameInstanceHead, which includes class identity and head type.
Changed overlap, imported duplicate, and imported overlap guards to compare instanceClassIdentity rather than raw instanceClassName.
Changed instance method lookup to match the current declaration's resolved class identity before selecting the instance head.
Added regressions for alias-equivalent duplicate heads and local same-named class instances beside hidden method-only imports.
